zh.summary: 追溯來源、辨認同源轉貼，核對時間與對象，留下有限且可驗證的結論。

sourceBody.text: CEH M02-02｜公開來源情報與來源查證：找到資料，不等於證明事情是真的
1. 先記住結論
OSINT 的價值，不是找到最多網頁，而是說清楚：哪一筆證據，在什麼時間，能支持哪一個有限的結論。 三個網站轉貼同一篇文章，不是三份獨立證據；一份真的舊文件，也不能直接證明今天的狀態。
想像你要去一間咖啡店：搜尋摘要寫晚上十點打烊，部落格說九點，店家最近公告則說裝修暫停營業。你不會把三個時間平均後出門；你會先問「哪個是原始來源？說的是哪一天、哪間分店？」資安情報也是如此。
本堂只閱讀人工製作的資料與公開方法文件，不對第三方帳號、主機或網站進行探查。
2. 知識地圖：公開資料如何變成可用情報？
OSINT，Open-Source Intelligence（公開來源情報），是針對問題，把公開可取得的資料蒐集、查核、分析後，形成能協助決策的情報。Open-source 在這裡不是只指開放原始碼。資料可能是真的、假的、舊的、片面的；「搜尋得到」只是起點。
Source Validation（來源查證）不是替網站貼一個永久可信標章，而是核對每個主張的來源、內容、時間、對象與支持程度。

visual.caption: 圖 1｜資料到情報
visual.description: 工作順序；查核不足保留待確認

items.title: 讀圖重點
items.body: 工作順序；查核不足保留待確認

sourceBody.text: 圖 1 的箭頭代表工作順序，不代表資料經過幾個步驟就自動變真。查核不足就走向「待確認」，而不是硬湊答案。
前一堂 M02-01 問「蒐集時有沒有直接與目標互動？」本堂問「拿到之後，能相信到哪裡？」這是兩條不同軸線：被動取得的資料仍可能錯；直接收到的回應也可能只有局部意義。M09 的獨立查證則提醒我們，不沿著可疑訊息提供的聯絡管道自證；現在進一步檢查資料是否真的來自不同根源。
3. 常見來源：知道它能說什麼，也要知道它不能說什麼

rows: 官方公告、產品文件
發布者在特定時間的正式說法、產品能力
所有部署都相同、公告永遠正確或仍有效
徵才、採購、技術文章
曾提及的技能、需求或技術選擇
現在每台正式主機都使用該技術
搜尋摘要、網頁封存
索引或保存當時看得到的內容
網站現在仍相同、未找到就是不存在
公開程式碼與文件
該版本檔案寫了什麼
正式服務正在執行這份程式碼
DNS、RDAP、憑證透明度資料
名稱解析、註冊資料、憑證紀錄等不同層次資訊
IP 上所有網站同一擁有者、憑證中的名稱現在一定提供服務
社群貼文、新聞與論壇
對事件的描述、時間與關係線索
帳號是真本人、轉述就是獨立證實

sourceBody.text: DNS（Domain Name System，網域名稱系統）處理名稱與網路資訊的對應；RDAP（Registration Data Access Protocol，註冊資料存取協定）提供結構化註冊資訊；Certificate Transparency，CT（憑證透明度）以公開紀錄協助監督憑證簽發。這些是不同種類的紀錄，不是「公司現況全知資料庫」。本堂不展開查詢操作，DNS／RDAP 細節留給 M02-04。RDAP 欄位可能因政策或權限而被遮蔽；CT 也可能記錄預憑證，不能直接當成網站已上線的證明。[來源：RFC 9537 §1](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9537.html#section-1)；[RFC 9162 §1、§3.2.1](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9162.html)（後者是 Experimental 文件，並非宣稱所有現行系統都使用該版本）。
MITRE 將公開網站、搜尋引擎、社群與程式碼儲存庫列為偵察來源；這說明資料曝光可能被利用，不表示每次閱讀都是攻擊。[來源：MITRE T1593](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1593/)
4. 六個查核問題：不要只問網站有沒有名氣
以下是本堂教學用檢查表，不是假稱官方固定六步法。

rows: 誰產生資料？
找原始發布者與其觀察能力
把轉貼者當目擊者
原文在哪裡？
追到原始文件、版本或資料集
只讀標題、截圖或 AI 摘要
說的是何時？
分開事件時間、發布時間、擷取時間
今天下載就當今天發生
說的是誰或什麼？
核對公司、網域、分店、版本與環境
同名誤認、測試環境當正式環境
有獨立支持嗎？
查第二個來源是否自己取得證據
多站轉載被算成多次證實
還缺什麼？
明列矛盾、缺口與替代解釋
為了交報告把未知寫成確定

sourceBody.text: Provenance（資料來源脈絡／來歷）是資料由哪些人、活動、材料產生的紀錄。W3C 的 PROV 模型提供描述這些關係的方法；有來源脈絡能協助評估可信度，但不會自動保證內容真實。[來源：W3C PROV Overview](https://www.w3.org/TR/prov-overview/)
Primary Source（第一手來源）是相對於問題的原始紀錄；Secondary Source（二手來源）則整理或轉述它。第一手不等於絕對正確：公司公告可以證明「公司如此宣告」，未必單憑公告就能證明服務真的已完成所有安全改善。
5. 三個網站，也可能只有一個消息來源

visual.caption: 圖 2｜數根源，不數網址
visual.description: 上方引用鏈；下方不同取得途徑

items.title: 讀圖重點
items.body: 上方引用鏈；下方不同取得途徑

sourceBody.text: 圖 2 上半部的箭頭是「引用／轉貼」，不是三個獨立觀測。下半部是不同取得途徑對同一個明確主張提供支持，才可能增加信心；仍需查日期、對象與資料品質。
假設論壇 A 寫「海嶼咖啡用系統 X」，部落格 B 引用 A，新聞彙整 C 又引用 B。三個網址實際共用 A 這一個根源。這叫 Circular Reporting（循環轉述／循環引用）：重複出現製造了「大家都這樣說」的錯覺。
Corroboration（交叉佐證）不是數網址，而是核對不同取得途徑是否支持同一主張。例如，一份當期官方部署說明與獲授權的現行資產清冊，都列出相同系統名稱與環境，支持力通常比三篇同源轉貼好；若兩份其實由同一個過期清單複製，獨立性仍然不足。

以上轉貼鏈是本堂合成例子；查證方法可參考 Berkeley Protocol 對來源、檔案、內容與外部佐證的區分，不能把這份方法指引當成特定案件的司法證據資格保證。[來源：Berkeley Protocol（2022），§176–194](https://humanrights.berkeley.edu/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/Berkeley-Protocol.pdf)
「查無資料」也不是「證明沒有」。搜尋可能未涵蓋該頁、資料可能未公開，或你使用了不同名稱。報告應寫「在本次來源與查詢範圍內未找到」，不要寫「絕對不存在」。
6. 完整案例：別把去年的徵才文變成今天的漏洞報告

visual.caption: 圖 3｜三個時間，兩種環境
visual.description: 合成案例，資料不等於現況

items.title: 讀圖重點
items.body: 合成案例，資料不等於現況

sourceBody.text: 以下「海嶼咖啡」與 coffee.example 完全虛構；所有文件都是教材自製副本。
你的問題是：「這家公司今天的正式客服系統，是否仍使用系統 X？」你取得三筆資料：

rows: E1
去年徵才文要求熟悉系統 X；今天才下載
去年的職缺曾提到這項技能；不是今天的部署證明
E2
本月官方技術文章說測試環境遷移到 Y
當期文章宣告測試環境變更；正式環境仍未知
E3
本週資產負責人提供獲授權清冊，列正式客服使用 Y
在清冊更新時間與涵蓋範圍內，支持正式客服採用 Y

sourceBody.text: E1 與 E2 不一定矛盾：時間、用途和環境都可能不同。E3 是補充的內部驗證資料，不是公開來源；報告必須分別標示，不能把內部清冊或其細節公開到 OSINT 教材裡。
合格結論可以是：「歷史公開資料曾提及 X；當期公開文章只談測試環境 Y；另經獲授權現行資產紀錄核對，正式客服於清冊更新日列為 Y。未驗證實際執行版本與弱點，不能宣稱存在可利用漏洞。」
Confidence（信心程度）是你對這個特定結論支持程度的判斷，不是隨便填的成功機率。若使用高／中／低，先訂定本報告的判準，並寫理由；同一來源對「曾發布過文章」可能支持很強，對「正式環境現在有漏洞」卻幾乎沒有支持。不要把信心等級冒充官方量表。
7. 留下證據，也保護人與資料

visual.caption: 圖 4｜原始證據與分析分開
visual.description: 保存與推理分開，雜湊不是事實證明

items.title: 讀圖重點
items.body: 保存與推理分開，雜湊不是事實證明

sourceBody.text: 圖 4 實線代表保存或追溯關係，虛線代表分析推論。原始資料與分析筆記分開，修改推論時不要覆蓋原文。
一筆有用紀錄至少包含：證據 ID、原始 URL／檔案版本、發布者、事件／發布／擷取時間與時區、相關原文與上下文、取得方式、支持的主張、限制與待查事項。時間查不到就留未知，不用擷取時間冒充發布時間。

Hash（雜湊值）可把檔案內容轉成固定長度的摘要，幫助之後比對是否仍是同一份內容。雜湊相同不代表內容是真的，也不證明誰寫的、何時寫的或是否完整。 比對必須有可信基準；雜湊並非數學上的絕對不碰撞保證。它解決的是特定的完整性比對問題，不是全套真偽判定。[來源：NIST FIPS 180-4](https://nvlpubs.nist.gov/nistpubs/FIPS/NIST.FIPS.180-4.pdf)這也連回 M01 的 Integrity（完整性）；不能把完整性直接當成真實性。

rows: 發布前審核技術與人員資訊
減少不必要曝光與冒充素材
審核清單、發布版本、負責人
原始副本與分析分離
讓別人能重查推論
證據 ID、版本、查核紀錄
最小蒐集與限制存取
避免情報庫變成個資或秘密集中處
蒐集目的、存取權、保存期限
保留反證與未知
降低確認偏誤
替代解釋、矛盾來源、待查清單

sourceBody.text: Confirmation Bias（確認偏誤）是只注意支持原先想法的線索。刻意問「什麼證據會推翻我的假設？」可以幫助減少它。公開不等於可以任意蒐集、重製或擴散；不要使用外洩密碼、登入他人帳號，或為驗證猜測而超出授權。若看到疑似秘密，依既有通報流程處理，不把秘密貼進報告或公開教材。
8. 三分鐘練習與小檢核
在紙上寫一個主張，畫出它引用的來源，再把共同上游圈在一起。最後補上「時間、對象、目前能說到哪裡」三欄。這個練習不需安裝工具，也不需查任何人的個資。
檢核 1：圖 2 中三個網站引用同一篇論壇文，能否說已經三方獨立證實？你會再找什麼？
檢核 2：圖 3 中 E1 是今天下載的去年徵才文，E2 只談測試環境。它們能證明今天的正式系統有 X 的漏洞嗎？為什麼？
檢核 3：你替一張截圖算出雜湊值，之後比對相同。這證明了什麼，還不能證明什麼？
檢核 4：搜尋沒有找到某個客服子網域，可以把它從現行資產清冊刪掉嗎？應如何寫出有邊界的結論？

sourceBody.summary: 參考解答：1. 三個網址不等於三個獨立來源
paragraphs: 不能。三者都追到同一篇論壇文，只有一條共同上游。應尋找取得途徑不同、時間與對象一致的原始紀錄，並核對它是否真的支持同一主張；不是單純再找第四個轉貼網站。

sourceBody.summary: 參考解答：2. 文件日期與環境不能混在一起
paragraphs: 不能。今天下載不會把去年的內容變成現況；徵才技能不等於正式部署，測試環境也不等於正式環境。即使確認使用 X，還需要版本、配置與弱點適用條件的另行授權驗證，才能討論實際弱點。

sourceBody.summary: 參考解答：3. 雜湊支持內容比對，不替故事背書
paragraphs: 若比較基準可靠，相同雜湊可高度支持保存內容未變，但不能保證截圖原本就是真的、由誰建立、何時拍攝或是否截掉重要上下文。也不是數學上絕不碰撞的保證。造假檔案也能算出正確雜湊。

sourceBody.summary: 參考解答：4. 搜尋的空白不是資產不存在的證明
paragraphs: 不能直接刪除。應記為「在本次指定來源、查詢與時間範圍內未找到」，保留涵蓋範圍的限制，再由獲授權的現行資產紀錄或負責人核對。不要為補足缺口自行掃描超出授權的目標。

sourceBody.text: 9. 一句話帶走
先追來源根，再對時間與對象；把觀察、推論、驗證分開寫，缺口就保留待確認。 下一單元 M02-03 才深入搜尋引擎與網站足跡蒐集；本堂的查核方法會一路沿用。

en.summary: Trace provenance, separate reposts from independent evidence, align time and identity, and report bounded conclusions.

sourceBody.text: CEH M02-02 | OSINT Sources and Source Validation: Finding information does not prove a claim
1. The conclusion first

OSINT is valuable when you can explain which evidence supports which bounded conclusion, at what time—not when you collect the largest number of pages. Three websites repeating one article are not three independent observations. An authentic old document does not automatically establish today's situation.

Imagine planning a visit to a coffee shop. A search snippet says it closes at ten, a blog says nine, and a recent announcement says it is temporarily closed for renovation. You would not average the closing times. You would ask which source is original, which date it describes, and which branch it concerns. Cybersecurity intelligence requires the same care.
This lesson uses synthetic records and public methodology documents. It does not probe third-party accounts, hosts, or websites.
2. The knowledge map: How does public data become useful intelligence?

OSINT, Open-Source Intelligence, means collecting, checking, and analyzing publicly obtainable information to answer a question and support decisions. Open-source does not mean only open-source software. The material may be true, false, outdated, or incomplete; finding it in a search is only a starting point.
Source validation means checking the origin, content, time, subject, and support for each claim. It is not a permanent “trustworthy” badge for an entire website.
Figure 1 shows a workflow, not a machine that automatically turns information into truth. Insufficient support leads to an unresolved item, not an invented answer.

M02-01 asked whether collection directly interacted with the target. This lesson asks how far the resulting information can be trusted. These are different axes: passively obtained information can be wrong, and a direct response can have limited meaning. M09's independent verification also taught us not to rely on contact channels supplied by a suspicious message. Here we additionally examine whether different records truly have different origins.
3. Common sources: Their uses and their limits

rows: Official announcements and product documents
A publisher's statement at a particular time; product capabilities
Every deployment is identical; every announcement is correct and current
Job ads, procurement notices, technical articles
Previously mentioned skills, requirements, or technology choices
Every production host currently uses that technology
Search snippets and web archives
Information indexed or preserved at a particular time
The website remains unchanged; no search result means nonexistence
Public code and documentation
What a particular file version contains
Production is running exactly that code
DNS, RDAP, and certificate transparency records
Different layers of naming, registration, and certificate information
All sites on one IP share an owner; a certificate name is currently an operating service
Social posts, news, and forums
Descriptions of events, dates, and relationships
The account is authentic; repetition is independent confirmation

sourceBody.text: DNS, the Domain Name System, associates names with network information. RDAP, the Registration Data Access Protocol, supplies structured registration information. Certificate Transparency, or CT, uses public records to help monitor certificate issuance. They are different records, not an all-knowing inventory of an organization. Query operations and DNS/RDAP detail belong to M02-04. RDAP fields may be redacted because of policy or access rights. CT can also contain precertificates, which do not by themselves prove a website is online. [Source: RFC 9537 §1](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9537.html#section-1); [RFC 9162 §1 and §3.2.1](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9162.html). The latter is Experimental; this is not a claim that every current deployment uses that version.

MITRE identifies public websites, search engines, social media, and code repositories as reconnaissance sources. This explains how exposure can be misused; it does not mean every reader is an attacker. [Source: MITRE T1593](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1593/)
4. Six checking questions—not just whether the website is famous
This is a teaching checklist, not a claim that an official framework requires exactly six steps.

rows: Who produced it?
Identify the original publisher and what they could observe
Treating a republisher as an eyewitness
Where is the original?
Trace the document, version, or dataset
Reading only a title, screenshot, or AI summary
When does it apply?
Separate event, publication, and collection times
Treating today's download as today's event
Who or what does it concern?
Check organization, domain, branch, version, and environment
Same-name confusion; testing treated as production
Is there independent support?
Check how another source obtained its evidence
Counting repeated copies as independent confirmation
What remains missing?
Record conflicts, gaps, and alternative explanations
Replacing uncertainty with certainty to finish a report

sourceBody.text: Provenance describes the entities, people, and activities involved in producing information. W3C's PROV model provides a way to describe these relationships. Provenance helps assess trustworthiness; it does not automatically establish truth. [Source: W3C PROV Overview](https://www.w3.org/TR/prov-overview/)

A primary source is an original record relative to the question. A secondary source summarizes or repeats it. Primary does not mean infallible: an announcement can establish that a company made a statement without independently proving that every promised security improvement was implemented.
5. Three websites may still have only one origin

visual.caption: 2 | Count origins, not URLs
visual.description: Top: citation chain. Bottom: separate collection paths

items.title: How to read the diagram
items.body: Top: citation chain. Bottom: separate collection paths

sourceBody.text: The upper arrows in Figure 2 mean citation or repetition, not independent observations. The lower paths represent different collection routes supporting the same explicit claim. They may increase confidence, but dates, subjects, and evidence quality still need checking.

Suppose forum A says Island Coffee uses system X. Blog B repeats A, and news aggregator C cites B. Three URLs share one root: A. Circular reporting creates the misleading impression that everyone has independently confirmed the story.

Corroboration means comparing evidence, not counting URLs. For example, a current official deployment document and an authorized current asset inventory may both identify the same system and environment. That usually provides more support than three reposts. But if both were copied from the same outdated spreadsheet, their independence is still weak.

This reposting chain is a synthetic teaching example. The Berkeley Protocol distinguishes source, file, content, and external corroboration. Its methodology does not guarantee admissibility in a particular legal proceeding. [Source: Berkeley Protocol (2022), §176–194](https://humanrights.berkeley.edu/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/Berkeley-Protocol.pdf)

“Not found” is not proof of absence. A search may not cover the page, the information may not be public, or a different name may have been used. Write “not found within these sources and this search scope,” not “definitely does not exist.”
6. Worked example: An old job ad is not today's vulnerability report

visual.description: Synthetic example; records do not equal current state

items.title: How to read the diagram
items.body: Synthetic example; records do not equal current state

sourceBody.text: Island Coffee and coffee.example are entirely fictional. All records below are manually created teaching copies.
Your question is: “Does this company's production customer-service system still use X today?” You receive three records:

rows: E1
Last year's job ad mentions X skills; downloaded today
That job ad mentioned the skill then—not proof of today's deployment
E2
This month's official article says the test environment moved to Y
A current statement about testing—not production
E3
This week's authorized inventory from the asset owner lists production customer service on Y
Supports Y within the inventory's update time and coverage

sourceBody.text: E1 and E2 need not contradict each other: time, purpose, and environment may differ. E3 is additional internal verification, not a public source. Label the distinction and do not publish the internal inventory or its details in OSINT teaching material.

A defensible conclusion is: “Historical public material mentioned X. The current public article concerns only the Y test environment. Separately, authorized current asset records list production customer service on Y as of the inventory date. Runtime version and weaknesses were not verified; exploitability has not been established.”

Confidence concerns support for a particular conclusion, not an invented probability of success. If using high, medium, or low, define the report's criteria and give reasons. One source can strongly support that an article was published but barely support a claim about a current production vulnerability. Do not present a teaching confidence scale as an official standard.
7. Preserve evidence while protecting people and information

visual.caption: 4 | Preserve evidence; separate analysis
visual.description: Preservation and inference differ; a hash is not truth

items.title: How to read the diagram
items.body: Preservation and inference differ; a hash is not truth

sourceBody.text: Solid arrows in Figure 4 represent preservation or traceability; the dashed arrow represents inference. Keep original material separate from analysis, so revising a conclusion does not overwrite the evidence.

A useful record includes an evidence ID, original URL or file version, publisher, event/publication/collection times and time zones, relevant text with context, collection method, supported claim, limitations, and unresolved questions. If a time is unknown, leave it unknown. Do not substitute collection time for publication time.

A hash maps content to a fixed-length digest and helps compare it later. A matching hash does not prove that the content is true, who created it, when it was created, or whether it is complete. Comparison requires a trustworthy baseline. Hashes do not provide an absolute mathematical guarantee against collisions. They address a particular integrity-comparison problem, not every aspect of authenticity. [Source: NIST FIPS 180-4](https://nvlpubs.nist.gov/nistpubs/FIPS/NIST.FIPS.180-4.pdf). This connects to M01's integrity concept: integrity must not be confused with factual truth.

rows: Review technical and personnel information before publication
Reduce unnecessary exposure and impersonation material
Review checklist, published version, responsible owner
Separate source copies and analysis
Allow reasoning to be rechecked
Evidence IDs, versions, verification records
Minimize collection and restrict access
Avoid creating a concentrated store of personal information or secrets
Purpose, access rights, retention period
Preserve counterevidence and unknowns
Reduce confirmation bias
Alternative explanations, conflicting sources, open questions

sourceBody.text: Confirmation bias means preferentially noticing information that supports an existing belief. Asking “What evidence would disprove this hypothesis?” helps counter it. Public availability does not grant unlimited collection, reproduction, or redistribution rights. Do not use leaked passwords, log into someone else's account, or exceed authorization to test a guess. If possible secrets appear, use the established reporting process rather than copying them into public material.
8. A three-minute exercise and reasoning checks

Write one claim on paper, draw its cited sources, and circle common upstream origins. Add three columns: time, subject, and the strongest supported conclusion. No installation or collection of anyone's personal information is needed.
Check 1: In Figure 2, three websites cite one forum post. Is this three-way independent confirmation? What would you seek next?
Check 2: In Figure 3, E1 is an old job ad downloaded today and E2 concerns only testing. Do they prove that today's production system has an X vulnerability? Why?
Check 3: You hash a screenshot and later obtain the same digest. What does that support, and what does it not establish?
Check 4: A search finds no customer-service subdomain. May you delete it from the current asset inventory? How should you state a bounded conclusion?

sourceBody.summary: Reference answer: 1. Three URLs are not three independent origins
paragraphs: No. All three trace back to one forum post. Seek original records obtained through different routes, matching the same time, subject, and claim. A fourth repost is not independent corroboration.

sourceBody.summary: Reference answer: 2. Do not mix dates and environments
paragraphs: No. Downloading an old document today does not update its contents. A desired skill is not a deployment record, and testing is not production. Even confirmed use of X requires separately authorized checks of version, configuration, and vulnerability applicability before a weakness can be established.

sourceBody.summary: Reference answer: 3. A hash compares content; it does not endorse a story
paragraphs: With a reliable baseline, a matching digest strongly supports that preserved content has not changed. It does not establish that the screenshot was originally authentic, who created it, its capture time, or whether important context was omitted. It is not an absolute mathematical collision guarantee. A fabricated file can also have a correctly calculated hash.

sourceBody.summary: Reference answer: 4. Search gaps are not proof of asset absence
paragraphs: Do not delete it solely on that basis. Record that it was not found within the specified sources, queries, and time, retain coverage limitations, and verify through authorized current asset records or the responsible owner. Do not probe an out-of-scope target merely to fill the gap.

sourceBody.text: 9. The takeaway

Trace the origin, match the time and subject, and separate observations, inferences, and verification. Keep unresolved gaps explicit. M02-03 next covers search engines and website footprinting; today's validation method continues to apply.
